headline: Nvidia Requires Chip Tracking for New Partners in Southeast Asia to Curb Diversion
summary: Nvidia is requiring new partners in Southeast Asia to adhere to tracking and monitoring measures to combat unauthorized chip diversions to China.
why: Compliance with export controls is critical for semiconductor firms navigating geopolitical trade restrictions between the US and China.

impacts.name: Nvidia
impacts.why: Enforcing stricter tracking mechanisms on regional partners helps Nvidia comply with international semiconductor trade regulations.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Stricter compliance mandates are introduced to prevent regulatory violations related to technology export restrictions.
